invented.quote: This year that elevator has been out of service on 41 days, roughly one day in every eight.
invented.why: The brief does not state the current date, so the fraction of the year that has passed cannot be calculated.

invented.quote: Others carry children, groceries and laundry up as many as eight flights of stairs.
invented.why: The brief mentions elderly and mobility-impaired residents, not residents with children or specific activities like carrying groceries and laundry up stairs.

invented.quote: Five months later, we're being told the same thing.
invented.why: The brief only implies it is September or later, not specifically November (five months after June).

invented.quote: But we haven't seen the assessment behind it, and our residents deserve to understand the decision.
invented.why: The brief does not say whether an assessment exists or whether management has shared it with the residents.
